interpretation.beforeFirstStableFrameMs: Input to timestamp of first frame of final accepted three-frame sequence; NOT pure read/IPC/layout time or exact first DOM availability.
interpretation.afterFirstStableFrameMs: Remaining accepted-frame interval and callback completion; NOT proven GPU, OS contention, layout, or GC duration.
interpretation.rpcIntervals: Host-realm request/response observation; includes scheduling/transport/handler waits. Union/envelope/sum are not separable CPU or disk costs.
interpretation.cohorts: Fixed ordered runs, not randomized independent samples. Descriptive worsening does not establish causal regression; no significance test or universal speedup claim.
interpretation.firstRowsMs: Not used: warm operations can observe old nonempty rows before the target state.

system.cpuScopeCaveat: Process CPU is multithreaded aggregate and misses unsampled start/end. Difference from cgroup CPU includes harness/sampler and cannot identify neighbor load. System steal is aggregate, not this app's stall duration.
